title: Research is refused at every entry point unless the project chose Tavily and this computer granted it
statement: Each research entry point - the research_capability, research_search and research_fetch tools Kiln registers in Pi, and bin/research.mjs - refuses unless the project's committed research choice is tavily AND this computer holds a standing research grant for it. The refusal happens before TAVILY_API_KEY is read and before any request is made, and it names a stable reason: no project context, the project record unreadable, research not chosen, this computer's consent record unreadable, or no standing grant. An unreadable record of either kind refuses; it is never read as permission. The project context is explicit: Pi receives the project root from the supervisor, and bin/research.mjs requires --project-root; neither guesses from the working directory. When research is not permitted at launch, TAVILY_API_KEY is kept out of the environment of both of the supervisor's children. Each refusal reason, and the permitted case, is covered by a test that also shows no key was read and no request was made when refused.
